name: Ayu
source:
A girl given to J for training. Her unknown master wants J to turn her into a perfectly subservient sex partner. If J refuses, Misery explains that she will be thrown out onto the streets. After Misery teaches her about sex, Ayu can't wait to be trained.

Yamame calls Ayu her younger sister although the two aren't actually related.
